source_title: Water Intelligence Annual Report and Financial Statements 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 29 and 30 state that the financial statements were approved and authorised by the Board on 16 June 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 27% to $32.4m, statutory profit before tax grew 34% to $2.36m and adjusted profit before tax grew 34% to $3.35m. The Group held $5.3m cash, broadly balancing borrowings and deferred acquisition consideration, and reported a favourable net-borrowing position supported by recurring income.
already_announced_exclusion: Completed franchise reacquisitions, strategic investment, technology spending and other transactions disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Strong revenue and profit growth plus a balanced funding position provide exceptionally strong contrary evidence. Acquisition obligations create only limited cash pressure.

source_title: Water Intelligence Annual Report and Financial Statements 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 30 and 31 state that the financial statements were approved and authorised by the Board on 8 June 2022; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 44% to $54.5m, adjusted profit before tax grew 36% to $6.9m and statutory profit before tax excluding a one-time gain grew 35% to $5.7m. Cash of $23.8m exceeded bank borrowings of $8.0m, producing net cash of $15.8m. Management nevertheless flagged fuel, materials, labour and retention inflation pressures.
already_announced_exclusion: Completed franchise reacquisitions, equity fundraising, Salesforce implementation and technology investments disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Exceptional revenue and profit growth and substantial net cash provide exceptionally strong contrary evidence. Explicit inflation and labour-retention language creates limited operating pressure.

source_title: Water Intelligence Annual Report and Financial Statements 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 34 and 35 state that the financial statements were approved and authorised by the Board on 26 June 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 7% to $76.0m, adjusted EBITDA grew 9% to $13.4m, adjusted profit before tax rose 12% to $8.7m and both adjusted EBITDA and adjusted PBT margins improved. Total net debt was $15.8m, but leverage remained low at 0.53 times adjusted EBITDA with untapped credit capacity. Management noted persistent inflation and sharply higher interest rates.
already_announced_exclusion: Completed franchise reacquisitions, regional-hub investments, training-centre construction and technology programmes disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Continued revenue and profit growth, improving margins and low leverage provide very strong contrary evidence. Net debt, interest rates and inflation create modest pressure.
